source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Inside an active volcano: driving and heavy, heat and danger, lava rumbling, relentless forward motion. Tempo 140 BPM, 4/4 time, key of C minor. Instrumentation: ostinato bass (low strings and synth-like bass), brass stabs, string stabs, pounding toms and taiko, anvil hits. Form: pounding intro, main riff, brass theme, riff returns. Duration: 75 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
